notablePrerequisites: Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three creatures.
easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Circle of Dreams Druid.
description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
